# Artifact Engine

A lightweight Express.js service for managing coding artifacts with unique IDs, metadata, and version history.

## Overview

Artifact Engine provides a REST API for creating, retrieving, updating, and managing coding artifacts. Each artifact has a unique identifier, supports tagging and categorization, and maintains a complete version history.

## Features

- **Unique ID Generation**: Every artifact gets a unique, collision-resistant identifier
- **Metadata Management**: Tags, categories, and custom metadata for organization
- **Version History**: Automatic tracking of all changes with diff support
- **Full-Text Search**: Search artifacts by content, title, or metadata
- **RESTful API**: Clean, intuitive API design
- **GitHub Integration**: Sync artifacts with GitHub repositories

## Quick Start

```bash
# Install dependencies
npm install

# Start development server
npm run dev

# Run tests
npm test

# Build for production
npm run build
npm start
```

## API Endpoints

| Method | Endpoint | Description |
|--------|----------|-------------|
| POST | /artifacts | Create a new artifact |
| GET | /artifacts | List all artifacts |
| GET | /artifacts/:id | Get a specific artifact |
| PUT | /artifacts/:id | Update an artifact |
| DELETE | /artifacts/:id | Delete an artifact |
| GET | /artifacts/:id/versions | Get version history |
| GET | /artifacts/:id/versions/:version | Get specific version |
| POST | /artifacts/:id/fork | Fork an artifact |
| GET | /search | Search artifacts |
| GET | /health | Health check endpoint |

## Documentation

- [Getting Started](docs/getting-started.md)
- [API Reference](docs/api-reference.md)
- [Architecture](docs/architecture.md)
- [GitHub Integration](docs/github-integration.md)

## Tech Stack

- Node.js with TypeScript
- Express.js for REST API
- UUID for unique identifiers
- In-memory storage (extensible to databases)
- Jest for testing

## License

MIT

import express from 'express';
import cors from 'cors';
import dotenv from 'dotenv';
import artifactRoutes from './routes/artifacts';
import githubRoutes from './routes/github';
import healthRoutes from './routes/health';

dotenv.config();

const app = express();
const PORT = process.env.PORT || 3002;

// Middleware
app.use(cors());
app.use(express.json({ limit: '10mb' }));

// Routes
app.use('/artifacts', artifactRoutes);
app.use('/github', githubRoutes);
app.use('/', healthRoutes);

// Root endpoint
app.get('/', (req, res) => {
  res.json({
    name: 'Artifact Engine',
    version: '1.0.0',
    endpoints: {
      artifacts: '/artifacts',
      search: '/artifacts/search',
      health: '/health',
      github: '/github'
    }
  });
});

// Error handling middleware
app.use((err: Error, req: express.Request, res: express.Response, next: express.NextFunction) => {
  console.error(err.stack);
  res.status(500).json({ error: 'Internal server error' });
});

app.listen(PORT, () => {
  console.log(`Artifact Engine running on port ${PORT}`);
});

export default app;

- **Purpose**: Create, retrieve, update, and manage coding artifacts with unique IDs, metadata, tags, and version history
